description:
Export the game headless as the file the Summer Games store takes: a bundle for iPhone, Android, macOS and Windows, a web build or a desktop download. Returns path, sha256 and size. Upload it with store.upload_file.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/export-game"}

alignDeclaration.description: A game with a server: set summer.build.json targetPlatforms to targets before exporting.

format.description: bundle (default): the summer.games store build. download: a web build or native download; the default when targets is ["web"].

project.description: Project folder with project.godot. Defaults to the MCP's bound project, then the working directory.

targets.description: Store platforms. Bundle: any of macos, windows, ios, android (omit to use every platform the project declares). Download: exactly one of web, macos, windows.

timeoutSeconds.description: Stop the engine after this many seconds (default 900; a first export imports every asset).

name: summer_export_game
title: Export the game
